name: B10-0146/2025 (PPE) – White paper on the future of European defence
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out what it wants from the upcoming white paper on European defence. It calls for much higher defence spending, joint buying of weapons and ammunition, more support for Ukraine, and a stronger European role inside NATO. It also asks for better funding, simpler rules for the defence industry, and more investment in new technology. These are requests and opinions, not laws yet.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks EU leaders to act on the white paper, due 19 March 2025.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, defence companies, and Ukraine, which would get more military aid.
- **What happens next:** EU leaders would meet to agree on the plans and funding.
